title: Concept: Meta tag delivers a CSP that permits inline script
description: unsafe-inline removes the main benefit of a script policy, and a policy delivered in a meta element is both weaker and easier to strip during injection. The combination leaves the page looking protected in a source review while inline script executes freely.
applicability: Responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy through a meta element.
risk: An injected inline script executes in the page origin, which allows session theft and page rewriting despite the declared policy.
